description: This file defines a template-based data structure and a message exchange class for handling type-length-value (TLV) data serialization, deserialization, and communication in a networked or inter-process context. It includes classes for request, response, and buffer management, as well as a message exchange handler that manages data flow, synchronization, and state changes.

classes.name: TypeLengthValueType
classes.description: A template struct implementing TLV (Type-Length-Value) serialization and buffer management classes: Request, Response, and Buffer.

classes.name: MessageExchangeType
classes.description: A template class managing message exchange logic, including data sending, receiving, state management, and synchronization, for a specific data exchange pattern.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the TLV data into a stream buffer.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies data from another request buffer if types match.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data from a stream buffer into the internal buffer.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances to the next TLV block in the buffer.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Locks an event or synchronization primitive.

methods.name: Unlock
methods.description: Unlocks an event or synchronization primitive.

methods.name: Acquire
methods.description: Attempts to acquire a lock or wait for an event with a timeout.

methods.name: SetEvent
methods.description: Sets an event to signaled state.

methods.name: ResetEvent
methods.description: Resets an event to non-signaled state.
